vulnerability_cn: 路由器分支重复扣账使 skim 耗尽 NEX 储备
vulnerability_en: Router branch double-debits transfers and corrupts reserves through skim
detail_cn: NEX._transfer 在涉及路由器时调用一次父转账后未返回，结尾再次转账。攻击者向 NEX/AIC 池补入带卖出税的 NEX，再 skim 到路由器；回执中连续两笔同额 31,739,425.952813599235352140 NEX 从池子转出，sync 后以少量 NEX 兑换 83,261,448.443378062678937598 AIC。池子净流出 40,279,208.819696511790081586 AIC，WBNB 退出量 32.361267289208020008。已取得两代币原始源码和回执；无完整内部跟踪、未重放。源表日期为 8 月 4 日，交易为 8 月 3 日 UTC；19,000 美元与其他估值不一致，金额留空。
detail_en: NEX._transfer calls the parent transfer inside the router branch, then falls through to another parent transfer. After a taxed NEX donation, skim to the router debits the pair twice: the receipt contains consecutive transfers of 31,739,425.952813599235352140 NEX each. After sync, a small NEX input buys 83,261,448.443378062678937598 AIC. Net pair outflow was 40,279,208.819696511790081586 AIC; the WBNB exit was 32.361267289208020008. Original token source and receipt are archived; full internal tracing and replay were not performed. The sheet date is August 4, versus August 3 UTC. The USD 19000 estimate conflicts with other valuations, so loss is blank.
loss_scope: The sheet reports USD 19000; observed conversion produced 21503.921643594504179252 BSC USDC before conversion to WBNB. No common valuation timestamp or aggregate loss basis was established.

verification_status.historical_call_targets: receipt_emitters_observed; internal calls not independently traced
